market_outlook.short_term: Markets recovering from Fed-sparked selloff with tech rally and $7T options day. Oil weakness and falling yields provide near-term support. However, political tension between Fed and Trump, plus AI governance headlines, create volatility. Gold/silver strength signals hedging demand. Expect range-bound equities with sector rotation into semiconductors and pharma.
market_outlook.long_term: Buffett succession and KKR's McVey's compounding thesis suggest a shift toward patient, concentrated ownership. AI capex cycle maturing (Dreamforce: older models suffice) may moderate tech multiples. Private markets and real assets (gold, energy infrastructure) gain relative appeal. US-China AI competition and data center energy policy will define 2027 investment themes. Mortgage rates and housing affordability remain structural headwinds.
